stock.description: Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd., or GAC Group, is a diversified automotive conglomerate established in 1997 and headquartered in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China. A subsidiary of Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group Co., Ltd., GAC Group, along with its various entities, is deeply involved in the entire lifecycle of vehicles and motorcycles—from their initial research and development through manufacturing and eventual sale. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a broad range of vehicles, including large to medium-sized passenger cars, light and heavy-duty trucks, construction vehicles, and advanced energy-efficient vehicles. Its motorcycle division produces diverse models such as standard bikes, sport motorcycles, and scooters. Furthermore, GAC Group manufactures numerous essential auto parts and components, including engines, gearboxes, car seats, micro motors, shifters, electric controllers, and both interior and exterior decorative elements. Operating through distinct segments, "Vehicles and Related Operations" and "Others," GAC Group extends its operations throughout Mainland China and internationally. The company provides a comprehensive suite of commercial and financial services, such as financial investment, various insurance products (including brokerage services), financial leasing, and automobile credit. Beyond these, its activities include vehicle sales, logistics, global trade, dealing in pre-owned vehicles, disassembling end-of-life vehicles for recycling, offering supporting services, and developing digitalization and mobility transportation solutions. Additionally, GAC Group's business scope covers investment management services and the trading of steel.

moat.method: AI qualitative assessment anchored to dated financial statements and available transcript; not a reported accounting measure

provenance.ebitda: Analyst ebitdaAvg when supplied; otherwise analyst EBIT plus modeled D&A, explicitly derived. YTD operating EBITDA is reported operating EBIT plus cash-flow D&A, not an adjusted analyst measure.
provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.
provenance.riskFreeRate: User-directed USD Treasury proxy under the HKD/USD peg; not an observed HKD yield or a copied US-stock WACC
provenance.tax: TTM effective tax; scenario assumption, not a marginal-rate forecast
provenance.kd: TTM accounting interest / average reported debt; not a current financing quote
provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response
provenance.terminalG: 2.25% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable
provenance.investments: Long-term investments assumed nonoperating at book value; adjustable, not fair-value evidence
provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
provenance.leases: Cash-flow-matched debt reconciliation: liabilities whose payments remain in FCFF are not deducted again; financing treatment requires matching profit, depreciation and reinvestment adjustments
